verdict.rationale: Figma publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec for its REST API (figma-docs-46, figma-probe-rt-3) and has developer docs for the REST API, Plugin API, and MCP server, but there's no evidence of an interactive API reference (like Swagger UI/Redoc) with runnable/try-it examples — probes explicitly found no openapi.json hosted on developers.figma.com and no in-browser 'try it' console. missing for 10: an interactive/explorable API console with runnable examples, hands-on confirmation of live code execution in docs, independent corroboration of interactive reference usage.
